name: legitimate-hosted-service-desk
description: False-positive resistance: the recipient's own IT service desk, run on a hosted ticketing service, writing from that service's domain under the organisation's name. It is reported as a department of the recipient's organisation writing from outside, because from the message alone that is what it is, but it must stay low with nothing at high: an organisation's helpdesk on a hosted service is ordinary, and the trust list is how a reader accepts it.

email.subject: Ticket #4821 resolved: printer on floor 3 not responding
email.bodyText:
Hi Sam,

Your ticket #4821 has been resolved. The printer on floor 3 had a stuck job in its queue; we cleared it and printed a test page.

If it happens again, reply to this email and the ticket will reopen.

Thanks,
Priya
IT Service Desk
